advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Clarify in docs that the AC-checkbox precheck only runs when the completion-verification close gate is enabled (gate-off closes are unaffected).
evidence: docs/plan-review-gate.md:903-904: 'Before the completion verifier runs, the close gate performs a deterministic check: if the ticket's `## Acceptance Criteria` section contains any unchecked `- [ ]` item, the close fails immediately'
transition_close.py:227-234 returns None (skipping the precheck at line 260) when `gate_enabled(... 'require_completion_verification_for_close')` is false
tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_ac_checkbox_precheck_heldout.py test_gate_off_unchecked_box_closes asserts an unchecked box closes when the gate is off
advisory.finding: The docs section states the AC-checkbox precheck runs 'Before the completion verifier runs' as if unconditional, but it only executes when `verify.require_completion_verification_for_close = true`; with the gate off (the default) the precheck is skipped entirely and an unchecked-box ticket closes.
scenarios: An operator reads the docs, expects unchecked AC boxes to always block close, but the gate is off by default and closes succeed.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add a sentence: 'This precheck runs only when `verify.require_completion_verification_for_close = true`; with the gate off no precheck runs.'

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Consider logging (debug/warning) when ensure_ac_boxes_checked swallows a reduce failure, so a silently-bypassed precheck is observable.
evidence: docstring at txn.py:442-443 documents this as intentional: 'Silently returns on any read / reduce failure so an unreadable ticket is never blocked here (other guards own that).'
advisory.finding: `ensure_ac_boxes_checked` swallows every exception from `reduce_ticket`/description read and silently returns without blocking, so a ticket whose description reduce fails (corrupt/partially-unreadable state) bypasses the AC precheck entirely — even though the billable verifier that follows may still run against it.
scenarios: A ticket whose reduced state throws → precheck is a no-op and an unchecked-AC close proceeds to the LLM stage.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm placing `ensure_ac_boxes_checked` in txn.py (vs. transition_close.py's precheck family) is an intended, in-scope location choice.
evidence: src/rebar/_commands/txn.py:438: `def ensure_ac_boxes_checked(ticket_id: str, tracker: str) -> None:`
Ticket Scope clause: 'src/rebar/_commands/transition_close.py (precheck family, alongside _completion_precheck)'; file_impact lists only transition_close.py + docs/plan-review-gate.md, not txn.py
advisory.finding: The precheck helper `ensure_ac_boxes_checked` was implemented in src/rebar/_commands/txn.py rather than in transition_close.py, which the ticket scope names as the sole precheck-family home ('alongside _completion_precheck'). transition_close.py only calls it.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm the additive `unchecked_ac_lines` extension of the shared _plan_clarity floor parser is intended in-scope enabling work (not an unscoped drive-by touch of a plan-review-shared module).
evidence: src/rebar/_plan_clarity.py:124: `        if item_unchecked and item_verbatim:` / :125 `            unchecked.append(item_verbatim)`
Ticket file_impact: only 'src/rebar/_commands/transition_close.py' and 'docs/plan-review-gate.md' — _plan_clarity.py is not named in Scope or file_impact
advisory.finding: The shared `_plan_clarity.py` floor parser was extended with a new `unchecked_ac_lines` field plus item_unchecked/item_verbatim tracking in evaluate_plan_clarity — a module used by plan-review det_floor/pass1 and engine_support gates — while the ticket scope/file_impact names only transition_close.py (+ docs).
